verifications.claim: The 2026 NHL Playoffs are set to begin on April 18, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Two weeks from Saturday, the 2026 Stanley Cup playoffs will begin.' (Saturday is April 4); R6: 'The NHL playoffs begin on April 18'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in R4 (April 4 + two weeks = 18) and R6 confirm the exact date.
